## Read Raw Data

```{r}
directory_baseline <-
  here("Data", "Acute Bout", "Pre")


not_all_na <- function(x) any(!is.na(x))
not_any_na <- function(x) all(!is.na(x))    
##Read baseline as for loop:
for(filename in dir(directory_baseline)){
  if (grepl("a.CSV", filename)){
    base_data <- read.csv(
          file = paste0(
            directory_baseline,"/", filename
        ),
        nrows = 1
      )
    df<-read.csv(
          file = paste0(
            directory_baseline,"/", filename
        ),
        skip = 2
      )%>%
      dplyr::select(
        where(
          not_all_na
        )
      )
    colnames(df)<-
      colnames(df)%>%
      to_snake_case()
    
    df<-
      df%>%
      mutate(
        timepoint = "baseline",
        id = to_snake_case(substr(filename, 1, 6)),
        date = base_data$Date[1],
        #hr_max = base_data$HR.max[1], HR_Max doesn't work like this, it's the same for all patients in this dataset (?)
        #hr_percent_of_max = hr_bpm/hr_max * 100,
        lubri_time = hms(time),
        start_time = hms(base_data$Start.time[1]),
        clock_time = lubri_time + start_time,
        total_calories = base_data$Calories[1]
      )
    
    assign(
      x=paste0("df_",filename),
      value =df
    )
    if(
      which(dir(directory_baseline)==filename)==
            grep(pattern="a.CSV",x=dir(directory_baseline))[1]
      ){
        out_data_baseline <- df
    } else {
        out_data_baseline <- 
          out_data_baseline%>%
          bind_rows(df)
      }
    
  }
}

directory_followup <-
  here("Data", "Acute Bout", "Post")


##Read followup as for loop:
for(filename in dir(directory_followup)){
  if (grepl("b.CSV", filename)){
    base_data <- read.csv(
          file = paste0(
            directory_followup,"/", filename
        ),
        nrows = 1
      )
    df<-read.csv(
          file = paste0(
            directory_followup,"/", filename
        ),
        skip = 2
      )%>%
      dplyr::select(
        where(
          not_all_na
        )
      )
    colnames(df)<-
      colnames(df)%>%
      to_snake_case()
    
    df<-
      df%>%
      mutate(
        timepoint = "followup",
        id = to_snake_case(substr(filename, 1, 6)),
        date = base_data$Date[1],
        #hr_max = base_data$HR.max[1], #HR max doesn't work from this, we should get it from the aerobic capacity data instead
        #hr_percent_of_max = hr_bpm/hr_max * 100,
        lubri_time = hms(time),
        start_time = hms(base_data$Start.time[1]),
        clock_time = lubri_time + start_time,
        total_calories = base_data$Calories[1]
      )
    
    assign(
      x=paste0("df_",filename),
      value =df
    )
    if(
      which(dir(directory_followup)==filename)==
            grep(pattern="b.CSV",x=dir(directory_followup))[1]
      ){
        out_data_followup<- df
    } else {
        out_data_followup <- 
          out_data_followup%>%
          bind_rows(df)
      }
    
  }
}
df_merged <-
  bind_rows(
    out_data_baseline,
```

## Create Datasets

```{r}
df_acute_bout_pulse<-
  left_join(
    df_merged,
    group_cytokine,
    by = join_by(id) 
  )%>%
  left_join(
    sex.hrmax.data, by = join_by(id, timepoint)
  )%>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("baseline", "followup")),
    treat = factor(
      case_when(
        timepoint == "baseline" ~ "control",
        T ~ treatment
      ), levels = c("control", "exercise")
    ),
    treat2 = factor(
      case_when(
        timepoint == "baseline" ~ "baseline",
        T ~ treatment
      ), levels = c("baseline","control", "exercise")
    ),
    hr_percent_of_max = hr_bpm/hrmax * 100,
    id_fix = factor(id),
    time_sec = lubridate::period_to_seconds(lubri_time)
  )%>%
  left_join(
    watt.data, by = join_by(id, timepoint, treatment)
  )%>%
  mutate(
    watt = case_when(
      time_sec < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      time_sec < 60 * 05 ~ watt_under_op_varmning_1,
      time_sec < 60 * 10 ~ opvarming_watt_2,
      time_sec < 60 * 14 ~ watt_1_interval,
      time_sec < 60 * 17 ~ watt_1_pause,
      time_sec < 60 * 21 ~ watt_2_interval,
      time_sec < 60 * 24 ~ watt_2_pause,
      time_sec < 60 * 28 ~ watt_3_interval,
      time_sec < 60 * 31 ~ watt_3_pause,
      time_sec < 60 * 35 ~ watt_4_interval,
      time_sec < 60 * 38 ~ watt_4_pause,
      time_sec<= 60 * 45 ~ watt_nedkøling,
      T~ NA_real_
    )
  )%>%
  mutate(
    watt_percent_max =
      watt / watt_max *100
  )


watt.aucs<-
  df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
  dplyr::select(
    id, timepoint, lubri_time, watt
  )%>%
  group_by(id, timepoint)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    WATT_AUC =
      AUC(
        x=lubri_time,
        y=watt,
    method = "spline", 
    na.rm=T,
      )
  )
write_xlsx(
  watt.aucs,
  path = (here("Data", "Acute Bout", "watt_auc.xlsx")))

write_xlsx(
  df_acute_bout_pulse,
  path = (here("Data", "Acute Bout", "Acute_bout_data.xlsx")))

  
av_bpms_watt<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_bpm+watt~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse, na.rm=T)

av_bpms_IFN_low<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_bpm+watt~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
                        dplyr::filter(ifn_1_netto <= 2)
                      , na.rm=T)


av_bpms_IFN_high<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_bpm+watt~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
                        dplyr::filter(ifn_1_netto > 2)
                      , na.rm=T)

av_percent_bpms<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_percent_of_max + watt_percent_max~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse, na.rm=T)

av_percent_bpms_IFN_low<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_percent_of_max+ watt_percent_max~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
                        dplyr::filter(ifn_1_netto <= 2)
                      , na.rm=T)


av_percent_bpms_IFN_high<-
  LMMstar::summarize(  formula= hr_percent_of_max+ watt_percent_max~
                        time + treat2,
                      data = df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
                        dplyr::filter(ifn_1_netto > 2)
                      , na.rm=T)


##Save summary stats

write_xlsx(
  av_bpms_watt,
  path = here("Data", "Acute Bout", "SummaryHR.xlsx")
)

write_xlsx(
  av_percent_bpms,
  path =  here("Data", "Acute Bout", "SummaryHRPercentofMax.xlsx")
)

write_xlsx(
  df_acute_bout_pulse,
  path = here("Data", "Acute Bout", "df_acute_bout_pulse.xlsx")
)
```

##Data frame to find maximal slopes for each individual

```{r}
#TODO find max og hældning af pulskurver. DONE
#Test frollsum and splinefun functions


df_acute_bout_pulse<-
  df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
dplyr::filter(
  id != "lup_032"
)%>%
  group_by(id, timepoint)%>%
  mutate(hr_slope = {
    # Remove rows with missing heart rate values
    valid_data <- na.omit(data.frame(time_sec, hr_bpm))
    # Fit a smooth spline to the heart rate data over time
    spline_fit <- smooth.spline(x=valid_data$time_sec, y=valid_data$hr_bpm, all.knots =T, df = 1000)
    
    # Calculate the derivative (slope) of the spline at each time point
    slope_values <- predict(spline_fit, time_sec, deriv = 1)$y
    
    # Return the slope values for each observation
    slope_values
  },
  hr_pct_slope = {
    # Remove rows with missing heart rate values
    valid_data <- na.omit(data.frame(time_sec, hr_percent_of_max))
    # Fit a smooth spline to the heart rate data over time
    spline_fit <- smooth.spline(x=valid_data$time_sec, y=valid_data$hr_percent_of_max, all.knots =T, df = 1000)
    
    # Calculate the derivative (slope) of the spline at each time point
    slope_values <- predict(spline_fit, time_sec, deriv = 1)$y
    
    # Return the slope values for each observation
    slope_values
  },
  hr_slope_30secsum = 
    frollsum(x=hr_slope, n = 30, align="center" ),
  hrpct_slope_30secsum = 
    frollsum(x=hr_pct_slope, n = 30, align="center" )) %>%
  ungroup()


df_acute_bout_pulse_summary<-
  df_acute_bout_pulse%>%
  group_by(id, timepoint)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    ifn_1_netto = ifn_1_netto[1],
    sex = sex[1],
    hrmax = hrmax[1],
    treat = treat[1],
    #Interval 1
    slope.in_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*9.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    slope.out_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*10.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    min(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    timezone5_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_percent_of_max)%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*9.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)%>%
        dplyr::filter(hr_percent_of_max>=85)%>%
        nrow()
    },
    #Interval % of max
    slope.pct.in_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*9.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    slope.out_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*10.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    min(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    timezone5_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_percent_of_max)%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*9.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)%>%
        dplyr::filter(hr_percent_of_max>=85)%>%
        nrow()
    },
    
    max_hr_interval1 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*10.5 & time_sec < 60*15.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    max_hr_perc_of_max_interval1 = max_hr_interval1/hrmax*100,
     #Interval 2
    slope.in_interval2 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*16.5 & time_sec < 60*22.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
   
    slope.out_interval2 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*17.5 & time_sec < 60*22.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    min(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    timezone5_interval2 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_percent_of_max)%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*16.5 & time_sec < 60*22.5)%>%
        dplyr::filter(hr_percent_of_max>=85)%>%
        nrow()
    },
    max_hr_interval2 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*16.5 & time_sec < 60*22.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    max_hr_perc_of_max_interval2 = max_hr_interval2/hrmax*100,
    #Interval 3
    slope.in_interval3 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*23.5 & time_sec < 60*29.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    slope.out_interval3 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*24.5 & time_sec < 60*29.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    min(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    timezone5_interval3 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_percent_of_max)%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*23.5 & time_sec < 60*29.5)%>%
        dplyr::filter(hr_percent_of_max>=85)%>%
        nrow()
    },
    max_hr_interval3 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*23.5 & time_sec < 60*29.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    max_hr_perc_of_max_interval3 = max_hr_interval3/hrmax*100,
    #Interval 4
    slope.in_interval4 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*30.5 & time_sec < 60*36.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    slope.out_interval4 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_slope_30secsum
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*31.5 & time_sec < 60*36.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    min(search_area$hr_slope_30secsum, na.rm = T)},
    
    timezone5_interval4 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_percent_of_max)%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*30.5 & time_sec < 60*36.5)%>%
        dplyr::filter(hr_percent_of_max>=85)%>%
        nrow()
    },
    
    max_hr_interval4 = {
      #Define search area
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*30.5 & time_sec < 60*36.5)
      
      #Get highest 30_second slope, remove NAs
    max(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    max_hr_perc_of_max_interval4 = max_hr_interval4/hrmax*100,
    mean.hr.1min.past = {
      #Define search area  from minute 0 to 1 after exercise
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*35-1 & time_sec < 60*36+1)
      
      #Get mean HR 1 minutes after exercise, deduct from max of interval4
    mean(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    mean.hr.2min.past = {
      #Define search area  from minute 0 to 1 after exercise
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*36-1 & time_sec < 60*37+1)
      
      #Get mean HR 1 minutes after exercise, deduct from max of interval4
    mean(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    HRR1 = {
      #Define search area  from minute 0 to 1 after exercise
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*35-1 & time_sec < 60*36+1)
      
      #Get mean HR 1 minutes after exercise, deduct from max of interval4
    max(max_hr_interval1,max_hr_interval2,max_hr_interval3,max_hr_interval4, na.rm=T)-mean(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)},
    HRR2 = {
      #Define search area from minute 1 to 2 after exercise
      search_area <- data.frame(
        time_sec, hr_bpm
      )%>%
        dplyr::filter(time_sec > 60*36-1 & time_sec < 60*37+1)
      
      #Get mean HR 2 minutes after exercise, deduct from max HR during bout
    max(max_hr_interval1,max_hr_interval2,max_hr_interval3,max_hr_interval4, na.rm=T) - mean(search_area$hr_bpm, na.rm = T)}
    
  )%>%
  mutate(
    slope.out_interval4 = case_when(
      slope.out_interval4 == Inf ~ NA_real_,
      T~slope.out_interval4
    )
  )
```

## Model on HRR

Okay with this dataframe we can test the intervals as models, but we probably need them in long format to be able to test all of them. We do the simple test each interval in/out as seperate LMMs first, then we might be able to combine into one model with 8 slopes (in/out) per individual.

```{r}
#HRR 1
HRR1_nointeract_lmm<-lmm(
  formula=
    HRR1 ~ 
    timepoint+
    sex+
    timepoint:treat,
  repetition = ~timepoint | id,
  structure = "UN",
  data = df_hr_change_group
)

summary(HRR1_nointeract_lmm)
levels(HRR1_nointeract_lmm)
coef(HRR1_nointeract_lmm)
plot(HRR1_nointeract_lmm, type = "scatterplot")
plot(HRR1_nointeract_lmm, type = "scatterplot2")
plot(HRR1_nointeract_lmm, type = "qqplot")
plot(HRR1_nointeract_lmm, type = "correlation")
plot(HRR1_nointeract_lmm,
     color="treatment")

#HRR 2

  formula=
    HRR2 ~ 
    timepoint+
    sex+
    timepoint:treat,
  repetition = ~timepoint | id,
  structure = "UN",
  data = df_hr_change_group
)

plot(HRR2_nointeract_lmm, type = "qqplot")
plot(HRR2_nointeract_lmm, type = "correlation")
plot(HRR2_nointeract_lmm,
     color="treatment")

    ifn_1_netto+
    ifn_1_netto:timepoint+
    ifn_1_netto:timepoint:treat,
  repetition = ~timepoint | id,
  structure = "UN",
```

```{r}
  plot(slope4.in_lmm, 
     type = "fit", 
     color="treatment",
     ci=F,
     time.var = "timepoint",
     obs.alpha = 0.5, 
     facet = ~ cut_interval(ifn_1_netto, 3))

ggplotly(slope4_plot$plot)
```

## Model on slopes out

Okay with this dataframe we can test the intervals as models, but we probably need them in long format to be able to test all of them. We do the simple test each interval in/out as seperate LMMs first, then we might be able to combine into one model with 8 slopes (in/out) per individual.

```{r}
  structure = "UN",
  data = df_hr_change_group
```

##Create Long Data set

```{r}

long_df_hr_change_group<-
  df_hr_change_group%>%pivot_longer(
    cols = 7:27,
    names_sep = "_interval",
    names_to = c(".value", "interval")
  )%>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_interval = paste0(
      timepoint, interval
    )
  )

```

##### Check what we are exporting

```{r}
export_plot.slope_in_nointeract_lmm
export_plot.slope_out_nointeract_lmm
export_plot.max_hr_obs_nointeract_lmm
export_plot.time_zone5_obs_nointeract_lmm

mt_summary_pulse.df_with_in_hyp<-
  mt_summary_pulse.df%>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Predictor")%>%
  mutate(
    in_hypothesis =
      case_when(
          grepl("interval", Predictor) & 
          grepl("treat",Predictor) & 
          type=="Main effects" ~ T,
          grepl("interval", Predictor) & 
          grepl("treat",Predictor) & 
          grepl("ifn_1_netto",Predictor) & 
          type=="Interaction effects" ~ T,
        T ~ F
      ),
    interval = case_when(
      grepl("interval1", Predictor) ~ "interval 1",
      grepl("interval2", Predictor) ~ "interval 2",
      grepl("interval3", Predictor) ~ "interval 3",
      grepl("interval4", Predictor) ~ "interval 4",
      T~NA_character_
    )
  )

mt_summary_pulse.padjust_df<-
  mt_summary_pulse.df_with_in_hyp%>%
    dplyr::filter(
      in_hypothesis
    )%>%mutate(
  p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))


mt_summary_pulse_export.df<-
  mt_summary_pulse.df_with_in_hyp%>%
  left_join(
    mt_summary_pulse.padjust_df
  )%>%
  mutate(
    `p-value` = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      p.value <0.05 ~ paste0("p =",round(p.value,3)),
      p.value < 0.999 ~ paste0("p =",round(p.value,2)),
      p.value < 1 ~ "p > 0.999",
      T~NA_character_
    ),
    `p-fdr-adjusted` = case_when(
      p_adj_fdr < 0.001 ~ "p-adj < 0.001",
      p_adj_fdr < 0.05 ~ paste0("p-adj =",round(p_adj_fdr,3)),
      p_adj_fdr < 0.999 ~ paste0("p-adj =",round(p_adj_fdr,2)),
      p_adj_fdr < 1 ~ "p-adj > 0.999",
      T~NA_character_
    ),
    across(is.numeric, ~ round_pad(.,2))
  )%>%
  relocate(
    outcome, interval, estimate, lower, upper, `p-fdr-adjusted`
  )%>%
  arrange(
    in_hypothesis
  )
  
  


mt_summary_pulse_export.df%>%
  write_xlsx(
    path = here("output", "acute bout", "tables", "Model_Tables_Summary_heartrate.xlsx")
  )
```

## Gam models

I considered not doing this, but I think it adds a lot to the analysis, considering whether pulse changes during the bout is dependent on baseline IFN-1 is just a logical way to check whether individuals who have a different IFN-1 drive have different heart rate variations based on exercise.

![](http://127.0.0.1:40349/chunk_output/s/A6397B00/c2f7xctscuxi7/000047.png)

```{r eval = T}
library(mgcv) 
pulse_gam_main<-
  mgcv::gam(
  hr_bpm ~
    timepoint+ 
    treat:timepoint+
    sex +
    s(time_sec,  by = treat, k = 20)+
    s(id_fix, bs = "re"),
  data = df_acute_bout_pulse,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)
summary(pulse_gam_main)
mgcv::vis.gam(pulse_gam_main,  view = c("treat","timepoint"))
plot(pulse_gam_main)
gam.check(pulse_gam_main)
plot_puls_gam_main<-
  pulse_gam_main%>%
  plot_predictions( 
                 condition = c("time_sec","treat","timepoint"),
                 conf_level = 0.95,
                 type = 'response', rug = T) +
  labs(y =  "Heart Rate",
       x = "Time During Bout (second)",
       color = "Treatment",
       fill = "Treatment",
       title = "Average smooth effect of treatment & time during bout")+
  ylim(0,200)+
  theme_bw()

plot_puls_gam_main

perc_pulse_gam_main<-
  mgcv::gam(
  hr_percent_of_max ~
    sex+
    timepoint+
    treat:timepoint+
    s(time_sec,  by = treat, k = 20)+
    s(id_fix, bs = "re"),
  data = df_acute_bout_pulse,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)
summary(perc_pulse_gam_main)
vis.gam(perc_pulse_gam_main)
plot(perc_pulse_gam_main)
gam.check(perc_pulse_gam_main)

plot_perc_puls_gam_main<-
  perc_pulse_gam_main%>%
  plot_predictions( 
                 condition = c("time_sec","treat","timepoint"),
                 conf_level = 0.95,
                 type = 'response', rug = T) +
  labs(y =  "Heart Rate Percentage of maximal heart rate",
       x = "Time During Bout (second)",
       color = "Treatment",
       fill = "Treatment",
       title = "Average smooth effect of treatment & time during bout")+
  ylim(0,120)+
  theme_bw()

plot_perc_puls_gam_main

plot_puls_gam_main%>%
  ggsave(
    plot = .,
```

### Interaction Models

####30sec sum

```{r}

df_acute_bout_pulse_30_sec_average<-
  df_acute_bout_pulse %>%
  mutate(
    time_round_to_30sec =
      round(as.numeric(lubri_time)/30,0)*30
  )%>%
  group_by(id, timepoint, time_round_to_30sec)%>%
  summarise(
    hr = round(mean(hr_bpm, na.rm = T),0),
    ifn_1_netto = ifn_1_netto[1],
    treat = treat[1],
    sex = sex[1],
  )%>%
  mutate(
    id = factor(id),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint),
    treat = factor(treat),
    sex = factor(sex)
  )


pulse_gam_interact<-
  mgcv::gam(
  hr ~
    sex+
    timepoint+
    treat:timepoint+
    s(time_round_to_30sec, by = treat, k=15)+
    s(ifn_1_netto, by=treat, k =5)+
    s(time_round_to_30sec, ifn_1_netto, by=treat, k =5)+ 
    s(id, bs = "re"),
  data = df_acute_bout_pulse_30_sec_average,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)
summary(pulse_gam_interact)
plot(pulse_gam_interact)
vis.gam(pulse_gam_interact, view = c("timepoint","ifn_1_netto"))
gam.check(pulse_gam_interact)
slopes(pulse_gam_interact, 
  variables = c("ifn_1_netto"),
  hypothesis = ~ meandev,
  newdata = datagrid(ifn_1_netto = 0:6))


avg_slopes(pulse_gam_interact, 
  variables = c("ifn_1_netto"),
  #hypothesis =  ~ meandev,
  newdata = datagrid(ifn_1_netto = 0:6))

slopes(pulse_gam_interact, 
  variables = c("treat","ifn_1_netto"),
  hypothesis = ~ reference,
  newdata = datagrid(ifn_1_netto = 0:6, treat = c("exercise","control")))


plot_puls_gam_interact<-
  pulse_gam_interact%>%
  plot_predictions( 
                 condition = c("time_round_to_30sec","ifn_1_netto","timepoint","treat"),
                 conf_level = 0.95,
                 type = 'response', rug = T) +
  labs(y =  "Heart Rate",
       x = "Time During Bout (second)",
       color = "IFN-1 Score",
       fill = "IFN-1 Score",
       title = "Average smooth effect of treatment & time during bout")+
  ylim(0,200)+
  theme_bw()
```
